name: You Shall Not Pass
primary:
Gandalf on the bridge of Khazad-dûm. You strike the ground with your staff and a shining barrier 9 blocks wide rises 3 blocks ahead of you for 8 s. Foes that step into it are thrown back to the far side; at most once a second:
• Damage 2 ❤ lightning (×2 on wet)
• Stun for 1 s
Enemy projectiles crossing the barrier burn up. You and your allies pass freely.
self_description: The barrier rises as a ring of radius 4 around you and throws foes outward.
